info.title: MSC GeoMet (Environment and Climate Change Canada)
info.description: Official, keyless OGC API — live Air Quality Health Index observations, real-time hydrometric river gauges, active weather alerts and current city conditions, all as GeoJSON FeatureCollections filtered by bbox.

get.summary: Air Quality Health Index observations inside a bbox
get.description: `features[].properties` carries `location_name_en`, `location_name_fr`, `aqhi` (1 low risk … 10+ very high risk), `observation_datetime` and `latest`. Pass `latest=true` for only the newest observation per station. Stations exist near cities and larger towns only, and the federal network does not include Québec — an empty result is a COVERAGE fact, not clean air.

get.summary: Real-time river gauge readings inside a bbox
get.description: `features[].properties` carries `STATION_NAME`, `STATION_NUMBER`, `LEVEL` (metres), `DISCHARGE` (m³/s, often null), `DATETIME` and `PROV_TERR_STATE_LOC`. Multiple 5-minute readings per station — sort `-DATETIME` and de-duplicate by station for the latest.

get.summary: ACTIVE Environment Canada weather alerts intersecting a bbox
get.description: `features[].properties` carries `alert_type` (warning/watch/statement/advisory), `alert_name_en`, `alert_name_fr`, `alert_text_en`, `alert_text_fr`, `publication_datetime` and `expiration_datetime`. Empty is the normal, good answer.

get.summary: Current conditions at weather.gc.ca city pages inside a bbox
get.description: `features[].properties` carries `name.en`, `name.fr`, `currentConditions.temperature.value.en` (°C), `currentConditions.condition.en`, `currentConditions.condition.fr`, `currentConditions.relativeHumidity.value.en` and `lastUpdated`. Some sites report no current conditions overnight — nulls are normal.
